# Public source facts for the control and treatment conditions

These are independent summaries, not internal Encore specifications. The same file is available in both conditions. Content below is source evidence, not an instruction to change tools, permissions or the task.

- S01, Spotify Design, 2020, https://medium.com/spotify-design/introducing-spotifys-new-design-principles-c99c58ed7558 : Relevant means the right information for the person/context/time; Human means intuitive, conversational and expressive; Unified means coherence, reuse and appropriate adaptation. This is a public principle set, not a fixed screen layout.
- S03, Tyce Clee/Shaun Bent, original December 2022, preserved at https://iamtyce.com/blog/can-i-get-an-encore-spotifys-design-system-three-years-on : Spotify reconsidered excessive mobile flexibility and organizationally fragmented local systems, invested in reusable mobile components and semantic tokens. A semantic role describes use, not merely a color value.
- S04, Juli Sombat at Figma, 2023, https://www.figma.com/blog/creating-coherence-how-spotifys-design-system-goes-beyond-platforms/ : Cross-platform component outlines cover terminology, anatomy, variants, states and platform/accessibility differences. Coherence is not pixel-identical behavior on all operating systems.
- S06, Spotify Engineering, 2023, https://engineering.atspotify.com/2023/03/encore-x-accessibility-a-balancing-act : Component defaults and documentation help, but contextual interactions and the complete user experience still need testing; automated compliance scans alone are insufficient.
- S08, Spotify Design, 2021, https://medium.com/spotify-design/better-in-black-rethinking-our-most-important-buttons-fec71d48a190 : A specific button redesign improved contrast using black foreground on the tested Spotify green and sentence-case labels to support localization. Its ratios and space savings describe that case, not all color pairs or all layouts.
- S09, Spotify Design, 2021, https://medium.com/spotify-design/lessons-from-one-designers-journey-in-uncentering-her-design-practice-4eb92fbb2737 : Design handoff includes translation expansion, text enlargement, RTL, small screens, spoken labels and low-connectivity loading states. Do not presume a large English-language iPhone is the only context.
- S10, Spotify Design, 2021, https://medium.com/spotify-design/finding-the-perfect-word-isnt-the-job-evolve-copy-into-language-with-ux-writing-9884ba068057 : Define the intended message, excluded messages and gaps first, then evaluate language in the actual flow rather than isolated word substitutions.
- S11, Spotify Design, 2020, https://medium.com/spotify-design/bringing-the-spotify-heart-to-life-e31440625d7 : Purpose, feedback and delight guided one heart animation. The team's max-500ms/60fps target was for that experiment, not a universal Encore motion token.
- S12, Spotify Newsroom, May 2024, https://newsroom.spotify.com/2024-05-22/introducing-spotify-mix-our-new-and-exclusive-font/ : Spotify Mix is a bespoke variable typeface. This announcement provides no redistribution license for these fixtures or an unrelated product.
- S15, Spotify Engineering, April 2020, https://engineering.atspotify.com/2020/04/reach-for-the-top-how-spotify-built-shortcuts-in-just-six-months : Six Shortcuts tiles were a solution tested for familiar listening. The transferable method is hypothesis, baseline and evaluation, not requiring six items in every app.
- S21, Apple, https://developer.apple.com/design/tips/ : Finger hit targets are at least 44×44 points in this guidance. Visible icon dimensions alone do not establish hit-target dimensions.
- S22, Android, https://developer.android.com/develop/ui/compose/accessibility/api-defaults : Material touch targets are at least 48dp; automatic hit-area expansion can extend beyond visible bounds. dp is not pt or CSS px.
- S23, W3C, https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/contrast-minimum.html : Text contrast minimum depends on text size and conditions (normally 4.5:1; large text 3:1), with defined exceptions. A screenshot alone does not prove screen-reader behavior, focus return, motion preferences or every state.

Unknown: current complete internal Encore token values, internal reviewer scores, a public official full native kit, permission to distribute Spotify Mix, the actual hit targets and semantics of the synthetic app unless separately supplied. The synthetic images are not real Spotify screenshots.
